transformations.name: Fideliscare_ip_claim_header_downstate_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_1 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_1 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_1 = '')

transformations.name: Fideliscare_ip_claim_line_downstate_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_2 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_2 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_2 = '')

derived_fields.name: claim_adjustment_type_cd
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN adjustment_claim_indicator_src_1 = 'O' THEN 'original' WHEN adjustment_claim_indicator_src_1 = 'V' THEN 'void' WHEN adjustment_claim_indicator_src_1 = 'R' THEN 'replacement' WHEN adjustment_claim_indicator_src_1 = 'X' THEN 'reversal' ELSE NULL END

derived_fields.name: gender
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN patient_gender_src_1 = 'M' THEN 'MALE' WHEN patient_gender_src_1 = 'F' THEN 'FEMALE' WHEN patient_gender_src_1 = 'U' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END

derived_fields.name: source_diagnosis_code_system
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN icd_version_src_1 = 9 THEN 'ICD-9-CM' WHEN icd_version_src_1 = 10 THEN 'ICD-10-CM' ELSE NULL END
